fields.Name: T301 - New Communication Channel To Message Type Cascade
fields.Description: Exercises the reactive provider->message-type cascade unique to the compose form (onProviderChange resets the selection and the filteredMessageTypes getter filters by CommunicationProviderID) — not the generic entity form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its New Communication (New Message) section. In the Message panel, open the 'Channel' dropdown. If one or more channels are listed, select one and watch the 'Message type' dropdown react. Success = the Channel dropdown renders and is interactive, and selecting a channel causes the Message type dropdown to appear/update for that channel (or stay correctly hidden if that channel has no message types) — seeing the Channel dropdown render and respond is success; you do NOT need to send anything. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Channel dropdown renders and can be opened, listing channel options OR a clear 'select a channel' empty option
After choosing a channel (if any exist), the Message type dropdown reflects that channel — it appears/updates, or is correctly absent when the channel has no types
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
